title: County of Marin Engage campaigns and questions
notes: One entry per campaign on Engage Marin. A campaign belongs to one project (project, an id from projects/projects.json) or one organization (organization, the last part of its id in output/organizations.jsonld).
The questions of a campaign are part of it. Each has its text and the link to it on Engage Marin.
The apps that show a project or an organization list its campaigns and their questions from here.

questions.text: What do you love most about Marin today?
What's your big, bold vision for Marin's future?
What are your ideas for Marin's future?
